SECURITY & EXPLAINABILITY

Built for clinical
research workflows.

TrialIQ is designed around traceability, human review and evidence-backed AI outputs.

Evidence-backed outputs

Every finding is grounded in the source document and presented with the context needed for human review.

Human-in-the-loop

TrialIQ assists clinical research teams rather than replacing qualified clinical or coding decisions.

Explainable by design

AI findings include confidence, source evidence and review status so users can understand why a result was produced.

Traceable workflows

Move from extracted information to review and action without losing the relationship to the originating clinical record.
